title: No permission request reached coax for a Bash touch in the trial run
body: In the trial run on coax-4da59a the agent ran `mkdir -p` and `touch` inside the project, and no `session/request_permission` reached coax. `~/.claude/settings.json` sets no `defaultMode`. Nobody has checked the cause yet. Candidates are an allow rule in Jack's settings, the mode the adapter starts a session in, or a mode it picks for a client that declares no capabilities. Until a request comes through, the permission prompt from 0548ccc is untested against the real adapter.
close_reason: Not a coax bug: the adapter starts sessions in Claude Code's auto mode (see the last note). coax-3ca4b5 shows the mode in the header and lets Jack change it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text:
Cause found. The Claude adapter starts every new session in Claude Code's `auto` permission mode when no `permissions.defaultMode` is set (`resolveInitialPermissionMode` in `src/session-mode.ts` of `claude-agent-acp` v0.101.0). In `auto`, Claude Code's own classifier approves actions it judges safe, so `mkdir` and `touch` inside the project ran without a `session/request_permission`. Jack's settings set no `defaultMode` and no permission rules.

Checked on 2026-11-09 with a `session/new` and no prompt: `modes.currentModeId` was `auto`, and the available modes were `default`, `acceptEdits`, `plan`, `auto` and `bypassPermissions`. coax's permission prompt works; the agent never asked.
